project: Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Animal Waste Cold Room — Mesaieed, State of Qatar
meta_rows: 40 working days (7 working weeks) from Day 0
banner: The programme runs from Day 0 — release of the 15% advance against the accepted advance bank guarantee and performance security cheque. It becomes date-bound on the day that release occurs.
completion_label: PROGRAMME COMPLETE — practical completion Day 36; handover and taking-over certificate
basis: Day 0 is the date on which the advance bank guarantee and performance security cheque are accepted by HBK-BWTC-BEIL JV and the 15% advance is released. Every working day below is counted forward from that date.
Working week: Saturday to Thursday, six working days. Fridays and State of Qatar public holidays are excluded from every duration shown.

Practical completion falls on Working Day 36 — twenty-four working days, or four working weeks, after delivery of materials to site. This is consistent with quotation DCTS/QT/SQ0005/2026, which states completion within 03–04 working weeks from the date of delivery, subject to site clearance. Handover, training and the taking-over certificate follow to Working Day 40.
Insulated sandwich panel availability is 03–04 working days from release of the advance, per the same quotation: the panel order is released on Day 5 and the material is available ex-works on Day 9.

payments.trigger: On acceptance of the advance bank guarantee and performance security cheque
After delivery of materials to site and joint inspection

client_obligations: Acceptance of the advance bank guarantee and performance security cheque and release of the 15% advance by Working Day 4. This is the gate on the whole programme: a day lost here is a day added to completion.
Site clearance, unobstructed access to the cold room area and a secure, weatherproof storage area released to TNDK by Working Day 10.
Concrete slab complete, cured and within ±5 mm over any 3 m, with the vapour barrier in place, before Working Day 13.
Approval of shop drawings, third-party verified design calculations and method statements within five working days of submission — Working Day 15. Panel erection cannot begin ahead of this approval.
Three-phase power supply at the plant location, with a distribution board and earthing, available before Working Day 25.
Work permits, gate passes and site inductions for TNDK personnel and subcontractors, issued before mobilisation on Working Day 13.
Attendance of the Client's and Consultant's representatives at the witnessed commissioning on Working Day 36.
Civil, structural, drainage, builder's work, fire detection interfacing and final painting are by others and are not represented in this programme.
qualifications: All days are working days counted from Day 0. The programme becomes date-bound only when Day 0 is fixed by acceptance of the securities and release of the advance; until then no programme day has elapsed.
Durations are stated in working days and the finish day of each activity is derived from its start and duration — no finish date is stated independently of the work it represents.
Single shift, normal working hours. Night working, Friday working and public-holiday working are excluded, and are available on written instruction as a variation.
The programme assumes continuous and unobstructed access to the cold room area throughout Phases 3 and 4, with no other trade occupying the space.
Delay attributable to any item listed under Client / Main Contractor Obligations entitles TNDK to an extension of time equal to the delay, without cost consequence to TNDK.

Interruption of site access, occupation of the cold room area by other trades, or a site-imposed shutdown operates as a day-for-day extension of the affected activity and of every activity that follows it.

The programme assumes uninterrupted availability of refrigerant and of the specified BITZER compressors. A supply interruption at the manufacturer is outside TNDK's control and is dealt with as an extension of time.
The scope represented here is that of LOA HBB000353-0 and quotation DCTS/QT/SQ0005/2026. Any scope added after approval of the shop drawings will be programmed and priced separately as a variation.

Comprehensive maintenance for the initial two years commences on the date of the taking-over certificate, in accordance with LOA clause 8(a). Extended maintenance beyond that period is a provisional item under Annexure-2 Part B and is executed only on written instruction.

The payment schedule shown is that of the LOA and is reproduced here only to show which programme events trigger which stage. Retention of 10%, released 5% and 5% in accordance with the LOA, applies to each stage.
This programme does not vary any contractual date. Where it differs from LOA HBB000353-0, the LOA governs.
